what_it_is.prose: Hamilton Sundstrand was a US supplier of auxiliary power units (APUs), electrical power-generation, actuation and environmental-control systems; in 2018 it was consolidated into Collins Aerospace under RTX. Its APUs (for example the APS-series) and electrical systems power a range of Western military and commercial aircraft, but as embedded components within OEM supply chains rather than through a discrete, publicly documented India defence contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card; see the Collins Aerospace card for the parent entity.
